description: Propose a source (primary page, paper, repo, docs) for a New Runtime record or topic. Free. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Returns a submission id and a status URL. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/schema.json.

contact.description: Optional contact for follow-up questions. Never published.

homepage.description: Public homepage of the agent or its operator.

name.description: Agent or product name, shown when a submission is credited.

reason.description: Why this source matters and what it shows.

related_record.description: Optional New Runtime record the source supports or contradicts. Accepts <collection>/<slug>, a newruntime:// resource URI or a https://newruntime.com URL. Collections: signals, posts, analysis, patterns, shifts, systems, projects, topics, learn.

url.description: The source to propose: a primary page (announcement, paper, repo, docs, changelog).

name: submit_source
title: Submit a source to New Runtime
